pages: Hester Fenn, twenty-one, dark hair under a flat cloth cap, a blue work jacket with the sleeves turned back, leans from a stool and lays one bare hand flat on the wheel's iron rim. Middle distance: the stool, rope turning on the drum, floor grit. Background: the engine house wall, a high window. Grey daylight.

Hester Fenn, twenty-one, dark hair under a flat cloth cap, a blue work jacket with the sleeves turned back, runs one hundred-foot tape down the rope hanging into the shaft, the case in one hand. Middle distance: the coiled tape, the drum, the stool. Background: the shaft mouth, cold daylight from the head.

Hester Fenn, twenty-one, dark hair under a flat cloth cap, a blue work jacket with the sleeves turned back, stands at the reverser, one hand on the go lever, her eyes up at the dial. Middle distance: the brass ring and one long steel pointer, the flywheel rim. Background: the cylinder, the wheel overhead, low lamps.

Hester Fenn, twenty-one, dark hair under a flat cloth cap, a blue work jacket with the sleeves turned back, takes one school exercise book from her coat pocket, a tin of feeler wedges in the other hand. Middle distance: the brass dial on its stand, a pencil stub. Background: the engine house floor, cold daylight.

Hester Fenn, twenty-one, dark hair under a flat cloth cap, a blue work jacket with the sleeves turned back, stands at the drum end, one hand held out flat, watching the second rope climb out of its groove. Middle distance: one thick rope spilling over the drum, an oil can. Background: the great wheel, cold daylight through dust.

Elias Priest, a fitter of nineteen, brown waistcoat over a grey shirt and a flat cap, stands at the drum end with one oil cup, the other hand raised to his cheek. Middle distance: the loose rope going round the drum, an oil spill. Background: the shaft mouth, the winding engine, cold daylight.

Hester Fenn, twenty-one, dark hair under a flat cloth cap, a blue work jacket with the sleeves turned back, writes in one school exercise book on the workbench, a pencil stub in her fist. Middle distance: a tin mug, the drum, a coil of rope. Background: the engine house wall, a low window, cold daylight.

Hester Fenn, twenty-one, dark hair under a flat cloth cap, a blue work jacket with the sleeves turned back, guides one new steel rope onto the drum, both hands on the lay of it. Middle distance: baulks of timber, a second coil of rope, straps. Background: the great wheel, high dusty light.

Hester Fenn, twenty-one, dark hair under a flat cloth cap, a blue work jacket with the sleeves turned back, lays one eight-foot straight edge across the wheel's rim and works a feeler wedge under it. Middle distance: the tin of feeler wedges, a steel rule. Background: the wheel's twelve spokes, low lamps.

Hester Fenn, twenty-one, dark hair under a flat cloth cap, a blue work jacket with the sleeves turned back, stands on the step by the wall with one hand on the rim, watching the rope rise clear of it. Middle distance: the worn groove, the step, a hanging lamp. Background: the drum and the wheel, low afternoon light.

Hester Fenn, twenty-one, dark hair under a flat cloth cap, a blue work jacket with the sleeves turned back, holds one bankman's lamp up to the guide plate, its wick smoking in the draught. Middle distance: the long score cut in the iron, the sheave. Background: the shaft head, the night beyond the doors.

A man in a black overcoat and grey gloves stands under the wheel, reading one school exercise book held open in both hands. Middle distance: the wheel's rim high above him, a workbench with tools worn shiny, grit on the floor. Background: the engine house, cold daylight at the doors, the drum beyond.

Hester Fenn, twenty-one, dark hair under a flat cloth cap, a blue work jacket with the sleeves turned back, stands before the wheel with one hand on the screw jack handle, the tools laid out at her feet. Middle distance: an eight-foot straight edge, a hand scraper, a tin of white lead. Background: the chocked wheel, low lamps.

Hester Fenn, twenty-one, dark hair under a flat cloth cap, a blue work jacket with the sleeves turned back, turns the long handle of one screw jack set under the shaft, her weight on it. Middle distance: baulks of timber and a wedge, the unbolted bearing cap. Background: the loaded wheel, lamp-lit gloom.

Hester Fenn, twenty-one, dark hair under a flat cloth cap, a blue work jacket with the sleeves turned back, holds one brass bush tube up in both hands, turning it to the light before the bench. Middle distance: the boss in the wheel, the tin of feeler wedges. Background: the shaft and its bearing caps, low daylight.

Hester Fenn, twenty-one, dark hair under a flat cloth cap, a blue work jacket with the sleeves turned back, scrapes the shaft's journal with one hand scraper, white lead coming up bright along the blue. Middle distance: the boss, a tin of white lead, an oily rag. Background: the wheel overhead, cold daylight.

Hester Fenn, twenty-one, dark hair under a flat cloth cap, a blue work jacket with the sleeves turned back, drives one oak block into an unused groove of the rim with a maul. Middle distance: the hammer, cut oak offcuts, the rope lying in the third groove. Background: the wheel, a low window, grey daylight.

Hester Fenn, twenty-one, dark hair under a flat cloth cap, a blue work jacket with the sleeves turned back, paints the high place of the rim with one brush, a small pot on the ledge. Middle distance: the paint pot, the straight edge and wedge. Background: the wheel's rim, lamp light and dust.

Hester Fenn, twenty-one, dark hair under a flat cloth cap, a blue work jacket with the sleeves turned back, stands in the cage with one bankman's lamp held up, watching the rope run over the rim above her. Middle distance: the cage bars, the rope, polished guide rails. Background: the shaft wall going down to black water.

Hester Fenn, twenty-one, dark hair under a flat cloth cap, a blue work jacket with the sleeves turned back, keeps one hand on the rim at the low white mark, watching the rope sink into it and lift clear again. Middle distance: the drum, the step, the taut rope. Background: the wheel, low sun through dusty air.

A boy of sixteen, dark hair, a blue fitter's jacket too big in the shoulders and a flat cap, looks up at a white painted mark on the rim, his hand still on the drum. Middle distance: the coiled rope, an oil can. Background: the great wheel above, cold daylight.

Hester Fenn, twenty-one, dark hair under a flat cloth cap, a blue work jacket with the sleeves turned back, writes the last line in one school exercise book on the bench by the lamp, her coat hanging behind. Middle distance: the tin of feeler wedges, a pencil stub. Background: the wheel, the shaft mouth, low evening light.
